lines.en: Would you like to respond?
: {i}I think you might have sent this to the wrong number.{/i}
: {i}Do you not like cats?{/i}
: {i}They’re fine. You just don’t really talk to me anymore (for good reason).{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}猫挺好的。只是你最近都不怎么跟我说话了（理由很充分）。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Should I not have sent this to you?{/i}
: {i}You actually did it on purpose?{/i}
: {i}I thought you might like to see it.{/i}
: {i}I like this part a little bit more, admittedly.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不过说实话，我更喜欢这一部分。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Texting me?{/i}
: {i}That was the implication, yes.{/i}
: {i}We’ve never really done that before. It feels kind of weird.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我们以前从来没这么做过。感觉有点怪。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Karin, what’s going on right now? Is everything okay?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Karin，现在是怎么了？一切都还好吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Yeah, I’m fine. Everything’s good.{/i}
: {i}I’m just wondering how you’re doing.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我只是想知道你过得怎么样。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Why? You’re not supposed to care anymore.{/i}
: {i}I don’t want to. But I do.{/i}
: {i}And I’ve been hearing things lately that make me feel worried.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}而且最近听到的一些事让我很担心。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}About me?{/i}
: {i}Yeah.{/i}
: {i}Like what? If you don’t mind me asking.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}比如什么？不介意的话能说说吗。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Like you and Ami getting into a fight. And her leaving.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}比如你和 Ami 吵架了。然后她离开了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You must be lonely. And that makes me feel bad.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你一定很孤独。这让我心里不好受。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}There’s something else too, though.{/i}
: {i}Do you remember when we talked near your house? And you told me that sometimes you can’t control yourself?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你还记得我们在你家附近那次谈话吗？你跟我说过，有时候你控制不住自己。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I remember saying a lot that day, and I remember you believing almost none of it.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我记得那天说了很多，也记得你几乎一句都不信。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Because I was mad and I thought you were making up excuses.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}因为我在生气，而且我觉得你是在找借口。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}But I heard from Touka that you weren’t lying. And that you do sort of black out sometimes.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}但我从 Touka 那儿听说了，你没有撒谎。你有时候确实会有点断片。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And now you believe it?{/i}
: {i}Now, I have a reason to.{/i}
: {i}So...you’re not mad anymore?{/i}
: {i}I’m still mad.{/i}
: {i}You still admitted to feeling a certain way about me that isn’t really okay, Sensei.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你毕竟承认过，你对我抱有某种不该有的感情，Sensei。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}This is probably where we should stop texting. This isn’t the kind of stuff you want on your phone.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}大概发到这里就该停了。这种东西留在你手机里不太好。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I won’t tell anyone about this and I’ll delete everything after.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我不会告诉任何人，之后会把所有记录都删掉。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I’d call, but I don’t want to hear your voice.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我倒想打电话，但我不想听到你的声音。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Can I just ask you a question, though?{/i}
: {i}And I might have already asked it once, but so many things were happening back then that I can barely remember anything.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}可能我已经问过一次了，但那时候事情太多，我几乎什么都不记得了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Do you regret it?{/i}
: {i}Even if it was something you couldn’t control? Do you feel bad that it happened?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}就算那是你控制不了的事？发生了那样的事，你心里难受吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Of course. I never wanted to hurt you. You’re like the only person I know who’s never done anything wrong.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}当然。我从没想过要伤害你。你大概是我认识的人里唯一一个从没做错任何事的人。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I had no idea how scary you could be.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我之前完全不知道你会有多可怕。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Well, now you do. And now you probably won’t send me any more pictures of cats you find.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗯，现在你知道了。那以后你大概也不会再给我发你拍到的猫的照片了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Are you still going to the beach with your class? Even though Ami left and you’re not teaching anymore?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你还会跟你班上的学生去海边吗？就算 Ami 走了、你也不教书了？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I’m not sure yet. Why?{/i}
: {i}I’m going.{/i}
: {i}Trying to figure out where and when to avoid running into me?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}想打听清楚时间和地点，好躲着我？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I won’t do that. I just don’t want to be blindsided again.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我不会那样。我只是不想再被打个措手不及。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I’m mad, yeah. But I’m mostly just upset that things are the way they are now.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我是在生气，没错。但我更多只是难过——难过事情变成了现在这样。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I miss when we were normal.{/i}
: {i}You still are. I’m the one who fucked up, accidental or not.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你还是正常的。搞砸的人是我，不管是不是意外。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I don’t feel like I am. It’s harder to be happy now.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}可我不觉得自己正常。现在要开心起来变难了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And my heart keeps telling me to forgive you, but thinking about listening to it makes me sick to my stomach.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我心里一直有个声音让我原谅你，可一想到要听它的，我就恶心想吐。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I don’t want to feel this way anymore. But I don’t know what to do about it.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我不想再这样了。可我不知道该怎么办。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I’m not really sure what to say to you here, Karin.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我也不知道该跟你说什么好，Karin。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}If you see me again{/i}
: {i}Can you talk to me?{/i}
: {i}Really?{/i}
: {i}I won’t do it on my own.{/i}
: {i}I just think that maybe it will make me feel kind of normal again.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我只是觉得，那样或许能让我重新觉得正常一点。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I don’t know.{/i}
: {i}I have to go, though. I’m making dinner tonight.{/i}
: {i}Goodnight, Sensei.{/i}
: {i}I’m sorry you’re unhappy right now.{/i}
: {i}Goodnight, Karin...{/i}
: {i}Thanks.{/i}
